title: Giếng cổ
about: Round x5 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa"): an old well: a drop now and then echoing deep down, a singing bowl and the darkest pad, the sub. F sharp minor at 44 bpm. An original piece.
